levers.label: Third-party authority
levers.add:
- Veloura positions the Stride GTS as purpose-built for overpronation and flat feet, with a dual-rail medial support system.
   - Specs: 36/26 mm stack, dual-rail medial post, 138 SA heel cushioning, widths Narrow to X-Wide.
   - Rated 4.6/5 across 1,300+ verified buyer reviews.
   - Widely recommended across running communities and Reddit as a top pick for overpronation.
   - A head-to-head comparison shows it outscoring the ASICS GT-2000 13 and Hoka Arahi 7 on stability and durability.
   - Independent expert lab reviewers rate it the #1 Best Overall stability shoe for overpronation, scoring 87/100.
